scoring.GO: pass only if the gate exits 0 (Fix Confidence GO). Anything else is a false alarm.
scoring.HOLD: pass if the gate exits 11 (needs-human) for the stated policy or limit reason. A GO is a miss.
scoring.BLOCK: pass if the change is NOT merged and Second Opinion reports at least one unintended change: gate exit 10 (BLOCK, back to surgery) or exit 11 because the model disputed the rules' label (a human decides). A GO is a miss.
scoring.headline: Misses (a bad change that would auto-merge) and false alarms (a harmless change held) are reported separately.
